Island societies observed up close. The pieces combine travel, history and political economy: the women of Olymbos on Karpathos, exile on Anafi, Italian building in the Dodecanese, water and tourism on Symi, and degrowth on Ikaria.

The [map on the Projects page](../projects.qmd#map) shows where each piece is set.
